blocks.raw: # Viewing Power BI Dashboards on Insights
blocks.text: Viewing Power BI Dashboards on Insights

blocks.raw: # Introduction
blocks.text: Introduction

blocks.raw: The integration of Power BI dashboards into the Intouch Insights portal enables brands to visualise data through interactive and customizable reports. You can apply filters, explore metrics, and analyse data directly within the Intouch environment without switching platforms.
blocks.text: The integration of Power BI dashboards into the Intouch Insights portal enables brands to visualise data through interactive and customizable reports. You can apply filters, explore metrics, and analyse data directly within the Intouch environment without switching platforms.

blocks.raw: ## Features
blocks.text: Features

blocks.raw: The key features of Power BI integration are:
blocks.text: The key features of Power BI integration are:

blocks.raw: * **Embedded Power BI dashboards**
blocks.text: Embedded Power BI dashboards

blocks.raw: View and interact with Power BI dashboards directly within the Insights portal.
blocks.text: View and interact with Power BI dashboards directly within the Insights portal.

blocks.raw:
* **Scoped workspace per organization**

  Access Power BI dashboards in organization-specific workspaces. Each brand is mapped to its own workspace to ensure data separation and security.

* **Mark reports as favourites**

  Mark frequently used or important Power BI reports as favorites. Use the **Favorites** filter or section to quickly access these reports. The favorite status persists across sessions.

* **Configure organization-specific settings**

  Use secure, organization-specific Power BI credentials and workspace configurations to manage access and data visibility.

* **View dashboards in full screen**

blocks.raw: * **Use interactive controls**
blocks.text: Use interactive controls

blocks.raw: Interact with embedded dashboards using native Power BI controls:
blocks.text: Interact with embedded dashboards using native Power BI controls:

blocks.raw:
* Filtering: Apply filters to display only relevant data.
* Sorting:  Reorder data within tables and charts based on defined parameters.
* Slicing: Segment and explore specific subsets of data for detailed insights.

blocks.raw: # Use cases
blocks.text: Use cases

blocks.raw: 1. **Displaying reports with complex KPI conditions in Insights**
blocks.text: Displaying reports with complex KPI conditions in Insights

blocks.raw:
**Requirement**\
Display a report in Insights that uses key performance indicators (KPIs) based on complex conditions, such as calculating the number of active users during the 180 days from the reporting end date.
blocks.text: RequirementDisplay a report in Insights that uses key performance indicators (KPIs) based on complex conditions, such as calculating the number of active users during the 180 days from the reporting end date.

blocks.raw:
**Solution**\
Use embedded Power BI dashboards in Insights to create reports based on complex KPIs that cannot be configured directly in Insights.
blocks.text: SolutionUse embedded Power BI dashboards in Insights to create reports based on complex KPIs that cannot be configured directly in Insights.

blocks.raw: 2. **Reporting on custom fields in Insights**
blocks.text: Reporting on custom fields in Insights

blocks.raw: **Requirement**
blocks.text: Requirement

blocks.raw: Create and display brand-specific reports in Insights to include data stored in custom fields, such as the number of customers who signed up for the loyalty program using a mobile device. Insights reports do not natively support reporting on custom fields.
blocks.text: Create and display brand-specific reports in Insights to include data stored in custom fields, such as the number of customers who signed up for the loyalty program using a mobile device. Insights reports do not natively support reporting on custom fields.

blocks.raw:
**Solution**\
Use Power BI dashboards integrated with Insights to create and display reports using data from custom fields.
blocks.text: SolutionUse Power BI dashboards integrated with Insights to create and display reports using data from custom fields.

blocks.raw: 3. **Customizing report appearance**
blocks.text: Customizing report appearance

blocks.raw:
**Requirement**\
Customize the appearance of reports, such as font types, colors, and layout, that cannot be modified within the Insights UI.
blocks.text: RequirementCustomize the appearance of reports, such as font types, colors, and layout, that cannot be modified within the Insights UI.

blocks.raw:
**Solution**\
Leverage Power BI’s design capabilities to apply custom fonts, colors, and visual theming that can be viewed within Insights.
blocks.text: SolutionLeverage Power BI’s design capabilities to apply custom fonts, colors, and visual theming that can be viewed within Insights.

blocks.raw: # Viewing a Power BI dashboard report
blocks.text: Viewing a Power BI dashboard report

blocks.raw: To view a Power BI dashboards report, do the following:
blocks.text: To view a Power BI dashboards report, do the following:

blocks.raw:
1. In the Insights+ page, go to **Reports** > **Power BI reports.**\
   You see a list of available Power BI reports for the organization.
2. Click the Power BI report you want to view.\
   You see the Power BI report. Each report consists of graphical representation called visual.
3. (Optional) Hover over each visual to see the [available interactions](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/power-bi-dashboards-integration-into-intouch#interacting-with-visuals).

   **Note**: The filters and options to view the report vary based on the reporting requirements.

blocks.raw: ## Interacting with visuals
blocks.text: Interacting with visuals

blocks.raw: While viewing Power BI visuals embedded in Insights, you can interact with the data using supported actions. These actions appear when you hover over a visual.
blocks.text: While viewing Power BI visuals embedded in Insights, you can interact with the data using supported actions. These actions appear when you hover over a visual.

blocks.raw:
| Actions                        | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Copy                           | Copies the visual with a caption.                                                                                |
| Filters                        | Displays filters and slicers that affect the visual.                                                             |
| Focus mode                     | Expands the visual.                                                                                              |
| More Options > Export data     | Exports the data in a preferred format.                                                                          |
| More Options > Show as a table | Displays the data from the visual as a table.                                                                    |
| More Options > Spotlight       | Highlights the visual on a report page.                                                                          |
| More Options > Get insights    | Explores the data to find insights, such as anomalies and trends. This functionality is currently not supported. |
| More Options > Sort axis       | Rearranges the order of elements displayed on the x-axis or y-axis of the visual.                                |

blocks.text: Editing a Power BI dashboard report

blocks.raw: To request changes to a dashboard, such as updating KPIs, modifying dimensions, or adjusting filters, submit a ticket to the Capillary Product Support team with the specific changes required.

blocks.raw: # Limitations
blocks.text: Limitations

blocks.raw:
* **Access through Intouch only**: Power BI dashboards can be viewed only within the Intouch platform.

* **Mobile view not supported**: Dashboards are not optimized for viewing on mobile devices.

* **Not accessible via Power BI portal**: Embedded reports are not available directly through the Power BI web interface.

* **Editing Reports in Insights:** You cannot edit Power BI reports directly within Insights. All edits must be made in Power BI and updated through JIRA tickets.

blocks.raw: # FAQs
blocks.text: FAQs

blocks.raw: 1. Who can enable Power BI integration for an organization?
blocks.text: Who can enable Power BI integration for an organization?

blocks.raw: The Capillary Product Support Team (PST) can enable Power BI integration.
blocks.text: The Capillary Product Support Team (PST) can enable Power BI integration.

blocks.raw: 2. Who can edit the Power BI integration settings?
blocks.text: Who can edit the Power BI integration settings?

blocks.raw: The organisation Administrator or the brand manager can edit the integration settings.
blocks.text: The organisation Administrator or the brand manager can edit the integration settings.

blocks.raw: 3. What if I need to update my Power BI credentials later?
blocks.text: What if I need to update my Power BI credentials later?

blocks.raw: You can edit and save updated credentials in the Power BI **Settings** section. The system will revalidate the updated details.
blocks.text: You can edit and save updated credentials in the Power BI Settings section. The system will revalidate the updated details.
